pattern: 一 + M + N + 也／都 + 不 + V
title: 一 + M + N + 也／都 + 不 + V (not V even one N)
longExplanation: not V even one N. Pinyin: yī + M + N + yě／ dōu + bù + V
formation: yī + M + N + yě／ dōu + bù + V

examples.romanization: wǒ yī gè píngguǒ yě bù chī。
examples.translation: I’m not eating any apples. (Lit. I don’t eat even one apple.)

examples.romanization: nǐ bù qù， nà wǒ yě bù qù le。
examples.translation: [If] you don’t go, then I won’t go either.

examples.sentence: A: 我早就复习好了。B: 那也不能一直玩儿啊。
examples.romanization: A: wǒ zǎojiù fùxí hǎole。B: nà yě bùnéng yīzhí wánr ā。
examples.translation: A: I’ve done my reviewed a long time ago already.

title: V1了就 V2 (V2 as soon as V1)
longExplanation: V2 as soon as V1. Pinyin: V1 le jiù V2

examples.sentence: 爸爸回来了我们就吃饭。
examples.romanization: bàba huílai le wǒmen jiù chīfàn。
examples.translation: We’ll eat when dad comes back.

title: V 来／去 ((complements of direction))
longExplanation: (complements of direction). Pinyin: V lái／ qù

examples.sentence: 我们在楼上等你呢，你上来吧。
examples.romanization: wǒmen zài lóushàng děng nǐ ne， nǐ shànglái ba。
examples.translation: We are upstairs waiting, please come up.

title: V somewhere 来／去 ((complements of direction))
longExplanation: (complements of direction). Pinyin: V somewhere lái／ qù

title: V O 来／去 ((complements of direction))
longExplanation: (complements of direction). Pinyin: V O lái／ qù

examples.translation: You need to bring [your] homework tomorrow.

title: V 来／去 O ((complements of direction))
longExplanation: (complements of direction). Pinyin: V lái／ qù O

title: 能……吗？ (how can you…?)
longExplanation: how can you…?. Pinyin: néng…… ma？

examples.sentence: 你不做作业，也不练习，能学好汉语吗？
examples.romanization: nǐ bù zuò zuòyè， yě bù liànxí， néng xuéhǎo Hànyǔ ma？
examples.translation: You don't do [your] homework, don't practice, how can you [possibly] learn Chinese well?

title: N1 还是 N2 ? (N1 or N2 ?)
longExplanation: N1 or N2 ?. Pinyin: N1 háishi N2 ?

examples.romanization: nǐ yào hē kāfēi háishi hē chá？
examples.translation: Do you want coffee or tea?

title: N1 或者 N2 (either N1 or N21)
longExplanation: either N1 or N21. Pinyin: N1 huòzhě N2

examples.sentence: 天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶很舒服。
examples.romanization: tiānlěng le huòzhě gōngzuò lèi le de shíhou， hē bēi rèchá hěn shūfu。
examples.translation: When the weather is cold or when you’re tired from work, it is very comfortable to drink a cup of hot tea.

title: N1 还是 N2 (N1 or N2 (in question-like clauses))
longExplanation: N1 or N2 (in question-like clauses). Pinyin: N1 háishi N2

examples.sentence: 我还没想好去爬山还是去看电影。
examples.romanization: wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎoqù páshān háishi qù kàn diànyǐng。
examples.translation: I haven't decided whether to go hiking or to go to the movies.

title: PLACE + V + 着 + N (There is N V’ed in PLACE.)
shortExplanation: There is N V’ed in PLACE.
longExplanation: There is N V’ed in PLACE.. Pinyin: PLACE + V + zhe + N

examples.romanization: zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe yī bēi kāfēi。
examples.translation: There is a cup of coffee placed on the table.

pattern: PLACE + 没 + V + 着 + N
title: PLACE + 没 + V + 着 + N (There is not N V’ed in PLACE.)
shortExplanation: There is not N V’ed in PLACE.
longExplanation: There is not N V’ed in PLACE.. Pinyin: PLACE + méi + V + zhe + N

examples.romanization: zhuōzi shàng méi fàng zhe kāfēi。
examples.translation: There was no coffee placed on the table.

title: 会 + V / A + (的） (will V, will be A)
longExplanation: will V, will be A. Pinyin: huì + V / A + ( de）

examples.sentence: 你穿得那么少，会感冒的。
examples.romanization: nǐ chuān dé nàme shǎo， huì gǎnmào de。
examples.translation: You wear so little, you will catch a cold.
